header.title: Epistula Jeremiae: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Old Testament
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's tlg0527.tlg052.1st1K-grc1, from Open Greek and Latin's First1KGreek (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.

notes.urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0527.tlg052.1st1K-gr: 'Scarecrow' renders προβασκάνιον, literally a charm against the evil eye.

nodes.text: For as a scarecrow in a cucumber field guards nothing, so are their gods, wooden and overlaid with gold and overlaid with silver.
